## 更新 · What's new

- 公网中继升级到 Common Relay v0.2.1，支持 v2 端到端加密空间：设备组页显示成员列表与实时在线状态，可编辑中继配置、退出当前组，传统设备组可升级组管理配置。
  Internet relay upgraded to Common Relay v0.2.1 with v2 end-to-end encrypted Spaces: the group page shows members with live online status, lets you edit the relay config or leave the group, and legacy groups can upgrade group management.
- Mac：修复长时间未按键后，第一次按快捷键需要按两次才响应的问题——剪贴板的 ⌘V 监听改为只监听，不再阻塞系统按键。
  Mac: fixed shortcuts needing two presses after a long idle period — the clipboard's ⌘V monitor is now listen-only and no longer holds up system-wide keystrokes.
- Mac：全局快捷键改为独占注册，重建片段时截图、搜索、单词快捷键不再短暂失效；替换快捷键失败会恢复原组合。
  Mac: global shortcuts are registered exclusively and screenshot, search and word shortcuts no longer drop while snippets are rebuilt; a failed replacement restores the previous combo.
